design_change.observed_problem: Broker can successfully enable the one-shot Worker, but the platform may deliver it as immediate catch-up before a post-scheduler repository acknowledgement is committed.
design_change.remediation: Use outbox-style delivery precommit: Broker persists armed_generation and last_armed_at before enabling the Worker. No post-scheduler repository write is required for correctness. Failed/lost scheduling leaves armed>served and is retried as the same generation after stale timeout.
